text:
amy_sales: Customer (tier-1 bank) confirmed air-gapped POC. They asked for: signed delivery mechanism, upgrade cadence for the POC vs prod, required operator access, and a clear cost uplift for offline packaging. Can ops/SE recommend a simple plan we can price?

ben_se: quick constraints from my call: no outbound, no internet registry, no telemetry. They have a transfer policy: approved USB or couriered encrypted disk. Also need SBOM and provenance for model artifacts.

kiran_security: SBOM + signed manifest is a hard requirement. They want us to support either their root cert or a mutually agreed third-party signer. No shared keys. Remote exec is allowed only under signed emergency SOW.

amy_sales: noted. Pricing Q: will delta bundles reduce ops cost materially? customer asked if monthly deltas are cheaper than full-image drops.

tori_ops: yes, deltas are smaller and cheaper to produce and ship, but they require our bundling pipeline to support binary diffs and a validation step on the site. For POC: do one full bundle + two follow-up deltas. For prod: monthly deltas + quarterly full refresh.

ben_se: technical ask: include verification steps in the runbook, and an offline preflight that checks checksums, signature, and SBOM integrity before install. Example preflight snippet for jumpbox:
```
# verify signature
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify root.pem -signature bundle.sig bundle.tar.gz
# verify manifest
jq .manifest bundle.json | sha256sum -c -
```

kiran_security: add requirement: maintain two prior approved bundles in the local artifact store for rollback. No automatic rollback; ops must approve. Also require signed attestation for any hotfix applied outside normal cadence.

devsupport_bot: buildbot: artifact ready 2026-04-02T09:12Z sha256:deadbeef... sbom: available

tori_ops: delivery options: 1) sealed disk (AES-256, courier) 2) encrypted USB with FIPS-compliant key 3) signed container image on offline registry tarball. We should offer all three and let customer pick. Each increases PS time: disk courier ~8h ops, usb packaging ~6h, registry tarball ~10h (includes instructions to import into their offline registry).

amy_sales: great. For the SOW I'll need: scope (POC vs prod), hours, what we need from customer, acceptance criteria. Can someone call out acceptance criteria?

ben_se: acceptance criteria for POC: 1) bundle installs successfully on their isolated cluster, 2) run 10k tokens/min synthetic load within agreed latency SLA, 3) model outputs sanity-checked against reference prompts, 4) manifest and SBOM validated offline.

kiran_security: add: security review closed with "no remote exec required" response, unless emergency access is requested via SOW. Also include key mgmt options: customer-owned root cert OR Redwood-signed with HSM audit logs.

amy_sales: pricing recommendation?

tori_ops: POC: 24h SE effort (config + runbook) + 12h ops packaging + travel/courier estimate if sealed disk is chosen. Flat PS line + fixed offline packaging fee $3,500 (placeholder). Prod: onboarding + per-month delta management fee (suggest $1,500/mo) + per-bundle shipping/ops fees billed pass-through.

amy_sales: legal notes?

legal_maya: we'll add language: emergency remote exec only under explicit written authorization and SOW, Redwood personnel operate under named accounts, time-bound credentials, and access logs retained for X years. Also clarify liability for physical shipment loss is customer responsibility unless using Redwood vendor courier.

ben_se: operational checklist for handoff to customer: 1) manifest schema + example, 2) signed sample bundle, 3) preflight scripts, 4) install runbook, 5) rollback procedure, 6) support contact and escalation windows.

amy_sales: can we have that packaged into a single ZIP to hand them tomorrow morning? I need a short executive summary for the customer and an internal cost estimate.

tori_ops: yes. I'll assemble the package. ben_se will provide sample bundles and manifest. kiran_security will draft the key mgmt paragraph. devsupport_bot: scheduled artifact build for 2026-04-02 09:12Z.

amy_sales: thanks all. I'll present this in the customer call Friday. Please flag any blockers now.

kiran_security: one blocker: if they require customer-side key signing, we need an onboarding session to exchange root certs and test verification locally. Plan 2h session.

ben_se: noted. I'll add that to the runbook and block time on Friday.

amy_sales: perfect. :thumbsup:
